content.short: Wave is a leading high-performance self-custody wallet designed for the Sui and Move ecosystems.
content.description: Wave Wallet is a premier decentralized wallet natively built to provide users with a secure and intuitive gateway to the high-throughput Move-based ecosystem of Sui. As a self-custody solution, Wave ensures that users maintain full control over their private keys and digital assets while enjoying a seamless experience across diverse Sui-based dApps. The wallet features a suite of built-in tools for asset management, NFT discovery, and direct integration with the network's leading DeFi protocols. Wave Wallet focuses on security, performance, and accessibility, making it an essential component for both new and experienced users navigating the rapidly expanding Sui Layer 1 landscape, ensuring a frictionless Web3 experience.
content.meta: Wave Wallet is the leading self-custody wallet for Sui, offering secure asset management and seamless integration with the Move ecosystem.
